offering_description.value: Provides annuities and life insurance for individuals seeking retirement income, savings protection and death benefits. Also provides pension risk transfer and funding solutions to institutional customers.

primary_products.value: Fixed indexed annuities; fixed rate annuities; indexed universal life insurance; group annuities; funding agreements

primary_services.value: Insurance underwriting; pension risk transfer; policy and annuity administration

items.detail: Individuals saving for retirement, seeking retirement income or purchasing life insurance
Corporate pension plan sponsors and institutional funding counterparties

end_markets.value: Retirement savings and income; individual life insurance; corporate pension risk management; institutional funding

items.detail: Insurance premiums and investment spreads on assets backing annuities, life policies and institutional contracts
Policy charges and fees for insurance coverage and optional annuity benefits
Receives premiums and institutional deposits, invests backing assets and pays policy benefits and retirement income
Underwrites life and longevity risks for individuals and pension plan sponsors

geography_served.detail: Serves individual and institutional customers across the United States

company_size.value: Large national insurer with broad independent distribution and an established institutional retirement business

specialization.detail: Annuities, life insurance, pension risk transfer and institutional funding share insurance and investment capabilities

items.detail: Independent insurance agents and marketing organizations distribute annuities and life insurance
Banks and broker-dealers distribute retirement products
Institutional relationships for pension risk transfer and funding agreements

regulatory_exposure.detail: Insurance subsidiaries require state licenses and face state insurance department rules covering solvency, reserves, products and sales practices
